name: Steam-Headless
description: Native headless Steam Remote Play host: a GPU-accelerated Steam client running in a virtual Wayland/XWayland session without any physical display. Log in once in the browser, then stream your games to any device running Steam or the Steam Link app on the same network.

notes.text: A GPU (rendering and video encode) is required; the script passes it through automatically via `var_gpu`.

Log in to Steam once at https://<container-ip>:6080/vnc.html (self-signed certificate; or scan the QR code with the Steam Mobile App); the generated password is shown at the end of the installation. VNC clients and macOS Screen Sharing can use port 5900 instead.
Stream by signing in with the same Steam account on the client device; Remote Play discovery needs client and container on the same network (TCP/UDP 27031-27036).
Game libraries grow quickly. The root disk is thin-provisioned; enlarge it anytime with `pct resize <ctid> rootfs +<size>G`.
Virtual gamepad support installs a udev rule and a modules-load entry on the Proxmox host and binds /dev/input into the container; it can be declined during installation.
